description: This file contains mock distribution functions for use with the Abseil C++ library's random distributions, designed for testing with the Googletest framework. It defines mock classes and functions for various distributions such as Uniform, Bernoulli, Beta, Exponential, Gaussian, LogUniform, Poisson, and Zipf, to facilitate deterministic testing scenarios.

classes.name: MockUniform
classes.description: A template class for mocking calls to absl::Uniform with various interval types.

classes.name: MockBernoulli
classes.description: A class for mocking calls to absl::Bernoulli distribution.

classes.description: A template class for mocking calls to absl::Beta distribution.
